data.title: surf
data.content:
## Summary
surf.new is an open-source application designed for deploying and managing web agents to automate tasks such as scraping, form filling, and summarizing content. It integrates with frameworks like Browser-use and Claude Computer Use, allowing users to leverage various LLMs locally via Ollama or through commercial APIs.

## Key Points
- Introduction of surf.new as a playground for deploying web automation agents.
- Support for Browser-use, which achieves an 89% accuracy score on web agent benchmarks.
- Ability to switch between different agents and model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Ollama).
- Capability to automate complex tasks like scraping YouTube video data and pasting it into third-party apps.
- Step-by-step guide for local installation using Node.js, Python, and Steel.dev API.

## AI Concepts
Web Agents, AI Orchestration, Large Language Models (LLMs), Browser Automation Agents, Agentic Accuracy Benchmarks, Computer Use (Experimental)
